Specification of Platform Health Management
AUTOSAR AP R23-11
8 API specification
8.1 API Header files
This section describes the header files of the
ara::phm
API.
The generated header files provide the generated types for
Supervised Entitys
and
Health Channels
.
8.1.1
Supervised Entity
For each
Supervised Entity
, a separate namespace is generated.
Namespaces are used to separate the definition of services from each other to prevent
name conflicts and they allow to use reasonably short names. It is recommended to
define the namespace unique, e.g. by using the company domain name.
